harness.notes: js/audio.js is an ES module exporting sfx and music. music.play(id) creates/resumes the context itself (ac()) and starts a setInterval(150 ms) look-ahead loop with 0.5 s horizon. Music on by default, no localStorage. Loop = 4 bars x 8 eighth-notes = 960/bpm s.

notes: Very short two-voice chiptune loops (bass + lead); renderSec clamped to the 30 s minimum.
